DI63 is an ICD-10 diagnosis code representing cerebral infarction (hjerneinfarkt) [^src1]. It is a fundamental component of the clinical quality indicators used by the Regionernes Kliniske Kvalitetsudviklingsprogram (RKKP) to monitor the treatment of patients with [[atrieflimren]] (atrial fibrillation) in Denmark [^src1]. Specifically, DI63 is used to identify cases of [[iskaemisk-apopleksi|Iskæmisk apopleksi]] (ischemic stroke), which serves as a critical safety indicator reflecting potentially inadequate anticoagulation therapy [^src3].

To ensure comprehensive and accurate tracking of stroke incidence, data is extracted from the Danish National Patient Register (Landspatientregisteret) using DI63 alongside other relevant codes. It is frequently evaluated in combination with [[di64|DI64]] (stroke without specification of hemorrhage or infarction) and the supplementary action diagnosis [[dz501|DZ501]] (contact for other physical therapy) to capture the full scope of stroke events [^src2]. By standardizing these diagnostic definitions, RKKP enables consistent measurement and cross-regional comparison of cardiovascular care quality, ensuring that ischemic stroke events are reliably captured in the national atrial fibrillation database [^src3].
